buyer_persona: US small-business owner or office manager, business with 5 to 200 employees, no HR department, personally responsible for distributing the handbook and collecting signatures.
changelog: 1.0: Initial release with guide, 5-sheet workbook, and 4 document templates.
disclaimer: This kit is a process tool, not legal advice; confirm e-signature and retention practice with counsel. Have counsel review forms and retention before first use. No outcome promises are made.

faq.a: Keep every version row and its acknowledgment data for the retention period your counsel advises. Archive closed-cycle workbooks by version code.
faq.q: How many versions should we keep?

faq.a: Re-issue the current version the same day, record a new distribution date with a note, and set a short due date. Log the re-issue if the signature is still outstanding.
faq.q: What if someone loses the handbook?

faq.a: Use only a method your counsel confirms, apply it consistently, save delivery logs with the version record, and record the method on each log row.
Document promptly with witnesses on the refusal form, file it, log the event, close the chase row with that disposition, and consult counsel on further action.
faq.q: What if someone refuses to sign?

how_to_use: Set identifiers and storage, confirm signature practice with counsel, populate the roster, register the current version, distribute, log signed dates daily, review the chase list weekly during active windows, document refusals with witnesses, and run the annual review calendar.
limitations: Tracks acknowledgments; does not prove reading or understanding. Not legal advice. Requires consistent administration and protected formulas. Fits 5 to 200 employees without HR; larger or regulated environments need dedicated HR systems. Electronic storage requires backup and access control.
long_description: A spreadsheet plus forms system that dates every handbook edition, logs per-employee acknowledgments with coverage formulas, isolates non-responders on a chase list, documents witnessed refusals factually, and schedules annual review. Includes a plain-language guide with setup steps, weekly routines, illustrative examples labeled illustrative, checklists, FAQ, limitations, and disclosure.
name: Handbook Acknowledgment Tracker
outcome_statement: Maintain a dated record showing which handbook version is current, who acknowledged it and when, and what remains open, with refusals documented and annual review scheduled.
problem_statement: Unsigned or unversioned handbook acknowledgments collapse in disputes, re-signing after updates is chaotic, and email or paper tracking lacks reliable timestamps.
short_description: Version register, acknowledgment log, chase list, refusal form, and annual review calendar for small businesses without HR staff.
support: Included: setup and routine instructions in the guide. Not included: legal advice, handbook policy drafting, or e-signature validity determinations. Consult counsel for signature, retention, and dispute questions.
whats_included: workbook with 5 sheets: version register, employee ack log with signed/missing formulas, chase list, refusal log, review calendar
4 docx templates: acknowledgment receipt form, refusal documentation form, update announcement memo, annual review checklist
who_for: Owners and office managers in US businesses with 5 to 200 employees and no HR department who manage handbook distribution directly.
who_not_for: Businesses with a dedicated HR team or over 200 employees, or regulated or multi-state environments needing automated HR systems and counsel-directed workflows.
